source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): rewrite runner scripts to env-resolved bash
author: cubic-dev-ai
body:
<!-- cubic:v=9330a367-e928-4bf1-8779-660fd8ccdfac -->
<!-- cubic:review-run=54fe69ce-810c-582c-a1ea-006caee64409 -->
<!-- metadata:{"confidence":8} -->
P1: When a custom runner image omits `sed` or lacks an env-resolvable `bash`, this rewrite can stop `entrypoint.sh` before runner registration or make the runner scripts fail at execution. Enforce these runtime tool requirements for the configurable image or use utilities guaranteed by that image.

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI agents</summary>

```text
Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At packages/charts/gha-runner/src/construct.ts, line 67:

<comment>When a custom runner image omits `sed` or lacks an env-resolvable `bash`, this rewrite can stop `entrypoint.sh` before runner registration or make the runner scripts fail at execution. Enforce these runtime tool requirements for the configurable image or use utilities guaranteed by that image.</comment>

<file context>
@@ -61,6 +61,12 @@ if [ ! -f ./config.sh ]; then
+# The image has no /bin/bash — runner scripts are exec'd via shebang,
+# so rewrite them to env-resolved bash (the nix profile is on PATH).
+for f in ./config.sh ./run.sh ./env.sh ./run-helper.sh ./runsvc.sh ./svc.sh ./bin/*.sh; do
+  [ -f "$f" ] && sed -i 's|^#!/bin/bash|#!/usr/bin/env bash|' "$f"
+done
+
</file context>
```

</details>

P3: The new shebang-rewrite logic that fixes the live crash (config.sh: /bin/bash: bad interpreter) has no test coverage.
